# FESDIA

This is a published version of FESDIA. The archived version of FESDIA is
hosted in zenodo as DOI. See [zenodo
page](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.15479943) for reference.

## Installation

### System requirements

- R (version \>= 4.0.0)
- Rtools (version \>= 4.0.0)

Before installing the FESDIA, you will need to first install the
following R-packages and their dependencies:

- *deSolve*, for the dynamic models developed in dtR;
- *FME*, to fit models to data, for sensitivity analysis, monte carlo
  simulations;
- *plot3D*, required for simple plotting

The code can be installed using:

``` r
devtools::install_github("stanleesocca/FESDIA")
```

And you can test the code with

``` r
library(FESDIA)
sol <- FESDIAsolve()
plot(sol, which = c("FDET", "O2", "NO3", "SO4"), grid = FESDIAdepth())
```

Please cite the accompanying paper if the code is used in your work:

    Nmor, Stanley Ifeanyi, Eric Viollier, Lucie Pastor, Bruno Lansard, Christophe Rabouille, and Karline Soetaert. "FESDIA (v1. 0): exploring temporal variations of sediment biogeochemistry under the influence of flood events using numerical modelling." Geoscientific Model Development Discussions 2022 (2022): 1-42.

    Nmor, Stanley, Eric Viollier, Lucie Pastor, Bruno Lansard, and Christophe Rabouille. "Biogeochemical implication of massive episodic flood deposition: Model‐data integration." Journal of Geophysical Research: Oceans 130, no. 6 (2025): e2025JC022414.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`FESDIA-package`](https://stanleesocca.github.io/FESDIA/reference/FESDIA.md)
  : The FESDIA early diagenetic model.
- [`FESDIAbudgetO2()`](https://stanleesocca.github.io/FESDIA/reference/FESDIAbudget.md)
  [`FESDIAbudgetC()`](https://stanleesocca.github.io/FESDIA/reference/FESDIAbudget.md)
  [`FESDIAbudgetN()`](https://stanleesocca.github.io/FESDIA/reference/FESDIAbudget.md)
  [`FESDIAbudgetP()`](https://stanleesocca.github.io/FESDIA/reference/FESDIAbudget.md)
  [`FESDIAbudgetS()`](https://stanleesocca.github.io/FESDIA/reference/FESDIAbudget.md)
  [`FESDIAbudgetFe()`](https://stanleesocca.github.io/FESDIA/reference/FESDIAbudget.md)
  : Budgets for the CNPDIA or MPBDIA model.
- [`FESDIAdefault`](https://stanleesocca.github.io/FESDIA/reference/FESDIAdefault.md)
  : Model solutions to aid in solving new applications
- [`FESDIAdyna()`](https://stanleesocca.github.io/FESDIA/reference/FESDIAdyna.md)
  : Dynamic solution of the FESDIA model, calculating C, N, P, O2, Fe
  and S dynamics in the sediment.
- [`FESDIAparms()`](https://stanleesocca.github.io/FESDIA/reference/FESDIAparms.md)
  [`PHDIAparms()`](https://stanleesocca.github.io/FESDIA/reference/FESDIAparms.md)
  [`FESDIAdepth()`](https://stanleesocca.github.io/FESDIA/reference/FESDIAparms.md)
  [`FESDIAgrid()`](https://stanleesocca.github.io/FESDIA/reference/FESDIAparms.md)
  [`FESDIAbiot()`](https://stanleesocca.github.io/FESDIA/reference/FESDIAparms.md)
  [`FESDIApor()`](https://stanleesocca.github.io/FESDIA/reference/FESDIAparms.md)
  [`FESDIAirr()`](https://stanleesocca.github.io/FESDIA/reference/FESDIAparms.md)
  : Functions to retrieve parameters, porosity, depth and sediment grid,
  irrigation and bioturbation, for the FESDIA and PHDIA models
- [`FESDIAperturb()`](https://stanleesocca.github.io/FESDIA/reference/FESDIAperturb.md)
  [`FESDIAperturbFluxes()`](https://stanleesocca.github.io/FESDIA/reference/FESDIAperturb.md)
  [`FESDIAperturbSettings()`](https://stanleesocca.github.io/FESDIA/reference/FESDIAperturb.md)
  : Dynamic solution of perturbed system.
- [`image2D(`*`<FESDIAdyn>`*`)`](https://stanleesocca.github.io/FESDIA/reference/FESDIAplot.md)
  [`matplot1D()`](https://stanleesocca.github.io/FESDIA/reference/FESDIAplot.md)
  [`plot(`*`<FESDIAstd>`*`)`](https://stanleesocca.github.io/FESDIA/reference/FESDIAplot.md)
  : Utility functions for plotting FESDIA dynamic or steady-state model
  output.
- [`FESDIAsolve()`](https://stanleesocca.github.io/FESDIA/reference/FESDIAsolve.md)
  : Steady-state solution of the FESDIA model, calculating C, N, P, O2,
  Fe and S dynamics in the sediment.
- [`FESDIA0D()`](https://stanleesocca.github.io/FESDIA/reference/FESDIAvars.md)
  [`FESDIA1D()`](https://stanleesocca.github.io/FESDIA/reference/FESDIAvars.md)
  [`FESDIAsvar()`](https://stanleesocca.github.io/FESDIA/reference/FESDIAvars.md)
  [`PHDIA0D()`](https://stanleesocca.github.io/FESDIA/reference/FESDIAvars.md)
  [`PHDIA1D()`](https://stanleesocca.github.io/FESDIA/reference/FESDIAvars.md)
  [`PHDIAsvar()`](https://stanleesocca.github.io/FESDIA/reference/FESDIAvars.md)
  [`FESDIAextract()`](https://stanleesocca.github.io/FESDIA/reference/FESDIAvars.md)
  [`FESDIApH()`](https://stanleesocca.github.io/FESDIA/reference/FESDIAvars.md)
  : Functions to retrieve variables for the PHDIA and FESDIA model.
